en: Changed managed `extraKnownMarketplaces`: a declared name can't be added from another source, an entry from elsewhere is hidden, and plugins the declared marketplace lists are reinstalled from it
zh: 变更托管的 `extraKnownMarketplaces`：已声明的名称不能从其他来源添加，来自其他位置的条目会被隐藏，已声明 marketplace 列出的 plugin 会从该 marketplace 重新安装
